name: showreel-c3-optical-centre

voice.text: Your eyes are lying to you. This dot is in the exact centre. So why does it look too low? Turns out, your eyes see the middle a little higher than it really is. So designers nudge things up. Titles, buttons, even logos.

caption:
This dot is in the exact centre. So why does it look too low? 👀

Your eye puts the middle of a shape a little above the real middle (the optical centre).

1. Centre it by the maths.
2. Nudge it up a little.
3. Do it for titles, buttons and logos.

Save this for your next poster or slide. Did it look low to you too?

sources.title: Graphic design: the optical centre (Duke University, Connected Curriculum Project)
